metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-64849: MLflow contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that can allow attackers to reach internal or cloud metadata services and receive response_status and response_body.. Product: MLflow
properties.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message has "CVE-2026-64849" or RuleName has "CVE-2026-64849" or ProcessName has "CVE-2026-64849" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, EventID | where count_ > 5 // AZ-SSRF-005
